parts.text: Turn this figure into a different character, keeping the exact same hulking massive body shape, size, pose, camera framing and clay style: an undead retro-toy zombie slasher. Remove ALL machinery: no armor plates, no chrome, no pistons, no cables, no air tanks, no neck collar. His skin is icy retro blue zombie clay, with exposed white rib bones through torn holes in the chest and exposed white arm bones in the forearms. He wears a tattered purple jumpsuit with ragged holes and thick double gold neck chains. Replace the gold full mask with an original blue-violet HALF mask covering only the lower face (nose, mouth and chin) with raised violet dots, his angry bloodshot eyes and bald blue head visible above, with a slouchy purple knit beanie on his head. His right fist grips a gleaming GOLD machete dripping blood (no flames); his left hand holds a GOLD axe resting on his shoulder. Background: a retro pixel-art style log cabin interior sculpted in clay, chunky blocky pixel shapes, warm lamplight. No chevrons, no lettering.
